service_at_issue: Skilled nursing home health services (daily injections) for a beneficiary in an assisted living facility, Feb-Dec 2004
facts: The ALJ decisions concerned nursing services provided to Medicare beneficiary at his place of residence, an assisted living facility, by the Visiting Nurses Association of Chittenden and Grand Isle Counties, Inc., from February 29, 2004, through April 28, 2004, and August 27, 2004, through December 24, 2004.

On February 6, 2007, with the consent and participation of counsel for the appellant, the ALJ held one hearing on five appeals involving the same beneficiary and provider, but each with different dates of service. The provider was given notice of the hearing but did not respond or participate.
outcome_note: The Council reversed the ALJ and held the services covered because, giving great weight to prior favorable homebound decisions and with no change in his condition, the beneficiary remained confined to the home.
